fields.Name: Read Skill File
fields.Description: Returns the content of one file that belongs to an active skill (a reference document or example stored in MJ: AI Skill Files). When a skill with files activates, its file paths are listed in the activation message and this action is added to the run; call it with the skill name and a listed path when the skill's instructions refer to that file. Inside an agent run, only files of skills active in that run are readable.

fields.Name: Skill
fields.Description: Name of the active skill the file belongs to, as shown in the skill-files listing.

fields.Name: Path
fields.Description: The file's path relative to the skill folder, exactly as listed (for example references/api.md).
